completeness.why: Forecast passes its (already non-null) value to the new getScheduleAmount; the three server/shared sites still keep their own `== null ? 0 :` branch around the call although the decision includes the missing case and the existing getScheduledAmount decides it; the budget template is untouched and its rounding variant is not carried as an explicit option (no sign the omission was deliberate).

interface.why: Adds getScheduleAmount next to the existing exported getScheduledAmount, which already handles number, range and missing amounts; the new one omits the missing case, forcing callers to keep their own null check, and the template's rounding inconsistency is not made explicit.

disguised_duplication.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount re-implements the existing getScheduledAmount (number vs rounded midpoint) under a near-identical name instead of reusing it.
